## Purpose

Describe the defect, documentation gap, or research reproducibility improvement, and link any related issue.

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation / discoverability only
- [ ] Tests or reproducibility tooling
- [ ] Scientific methods or result-affecting code (requires independent evidence)

## Evidence and validation

- Base version or commit:
- Commands executed and outcomes:
- Data sources, licenses, random seeds, software versions:
- Tests not run / limitations:
- Expected effect on frozen manuscript claims or artifacts (ideally **none**):

## Integrity checklist

- [ ] I have not rewritten historical release tags or misrepresented publication status.
- [ ] Any tracked-tree SHA-256 manifest has been regenerated if required, without modifying frozen release artifacts.
- [ ] I have not committed credentials, protected participant records, restricted datasets, or unlicensed material.
- [ ] Quantitative claims are traceable to data and commands, not inferred from test pass rates.
